program='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [[8] * w for _ in range(h)]
    # Locate the two perpendicular border segments and their common corner.
    counts = {x: sum(v == x for row in grid for v in row) for x in set(sum(grid, []))}
    border = min(counts, key=counts.get)
    inner = next(x for x in counts if x != border)
    top = all(x == border for x in grid[0])
    bottom = all(x == border for x in grid[-1])
    left = all(row[0] == border for row in grid)
    right = all(row[-1] == border for row in grid)
    cr = 0 if top else h - 1
    cc = 0 if left else w - 1
    dr = 1 if top else -1
    dc = 1 if left else -1
    n = min(h, w)
    # The original border becomes the interior color, except at the corner.
    for c in range(w):
        if grid[cr][c] == border:
            out[cr][c] = inner
    for r in range(h):
        if grid[r][cc] == border:
            out[r][cc] = inner
    out[cr][cc] = 8
    # In the corner square, shift the two arms inward and keep the diagonal.
    for k in range(1, n):
        out[cr + dr*k][cc + dc*k] = 8 if k == 1 else inner
    for k in range(2, n):
        out[cr + dr][cc + dc*k] = border
        out[cr + dr*k][cc + dc] = border
    return out
'''
